responsibility: Primary NVPTX backend implementation for GCC’s RTL and target-hook layers. It owns the target’s calling convention, argument passing, stack and soft-stack handling, address legitimacy, symbol/memory-space encoding, assembler emission, builtin expansion, PTX instruction formatting, mode support queries, and OpenACC/OpenMP offloading support including SIMT, worker/vector/gang privatization, reductions, fork/join handling, and device property reporting, while installing the NVPTX-specific TARGET_* hooks that connect the generic middle end to PTX code generation.
same_name_distinction: Among the same-stem nvptx files, this is the executable backend implementation source: it defines functions, state, and TARGET_* hook bindings for NVPTX behavior, whereas nvptx.h provides macro/type declarations, nvptx.md provides declarative RTL patterns, and nvptx.opt defines command-line options.
